description: The application relates to the change of use of a limited part of the premises at 101b Blackhorse Lane to provide a small, ancillary brewery taproom, while retaining the primary use of the building for brewery production and associated B2 (general industrial) and B8 (storage and distribution) purposes. The building has a total floorspace of approximately c.644 sq.m, of which the proposed taproom would occupy around 190 sq.m with customer seating confined to approximately 120 sq.m. The taproom would operate as an ancillary facility linked directly to the on-site brewery, ensuring the main function of the premises remains industrial in nature, consistent with the role of the Blackhorse Lane area as a Strategic Industrial Location. Its operation would be appropriately managed in terms of hours, capacity, noise and customer activity to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers and to accord with the objectives of the Waltham Forest Local Plan relating to the retention of industrial capacity and the control of town centre and evening economy uses in industrial locations.
